test_case.test_name: Parameterized clpeak OpenCL GPU metric validation
test_case.purpose: Measure all approved clpeak metrics on the exact OpenCL GPU device and compare supported precisions and memory/latency results with versioned GPU limits.
required_package: GPU BDF/model and OpenCL ICD/platform/device mapping
Required precision/metric set and unsupported-feature policy
Metric-specific tolerances and clock/power/thermal abort limits
test_case.test_command: Capture GPU/OpenCL identity, clocks/power/temperature and health; validate pinned clpeak and target device; run complete clpeak for bound repetitions without truncation; retain every FP/integer/memory/latency result and one-minute observation telemetry; restore temporary profile and compare each required metric with its approved tolerance.
test_case.expected_result: All supported required metrics complete on the selected GPU, meet their limits and leave runtime/GPU healthy; unsupported precision is accepted only when authoritative capability data says N/A.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires exact device/runtime, full output, approved aggregation and every required threshold. Missing tolerance, wrong OpenCL device, truncated results or unproven unsupported feature cannot pass.
safety_gate: Restore clocks/power/runtime settings; no automatic rerun.
expected_evidence: GPU BDF and OpenCL platform/device identity
Full raw outputs for all repetitions
Per-metric threshold comparison and final health
test_case.recovery: On wrong device, OpenCL fault or thermal/power breach, stop the clpeak process, preserve complete platform/device diagnostics, restore the captured GPU profile and confirm the selected GPU and OpenCL ICD enumerate cleanly before release.
